_comment: Cross-engine parity fixture for the equal-power stereo pan/balance matrix (W3C StereoPannerNode law). Read by web test test/unit/utils/video-editor/stereo-pan-matrix.parity.test.ts (getStereoPanMatrix, src/workers/core/audio-dsp.ts) AND Rust test audio::mix::tests::stereo_pan_matrix_matches_shared_parity_fixture (stereo_pan_matrix, src-tauri/src/audio/mix.rs). DIVERGENCE excluded from this fixture: a non-finite balance — web sanitizes NaN/Inf to 0 (identity), native assumes the scene DTO already sanitized it and would propagate NaN. Only finite balances belong here. Clamping of out-of-range finite balances (e.g. -2, 2) IS shared and covered below.
